## Calculate the BaseEF and EF

```{r EF caluclation}

USData <- read_rds("../Input/US_Direct_Crop_2018-2022.rds") # silage included data


#Calculate the EF
Result <- N2OEF_direct(USData) 


write.csv(Result$Result_Prov_Crop,"../Output/Direct N2O_CRN_US.csv",row.names = FALSE)

summary(Result$Result_Prov_Crop$N2O.IEF)
#mean IEF = 0.005853, median IEF = 0.005698
```
